routes.label: at the General Commissariat for Migration, in person

note: The ordinary passport's tariff, 300,000 Burundian francs for adult and child alike, valid 10 years for an adult and 5 for a child, granted at the General Commissariat for Migration, from the Commissariat's own page (undated, read 2026-11-03). Until 2026-11-03 the price was the 235,000 francs the Commissioner General gave at the East African Community passport's launch (Iwacu, 29 May 2018). The page names no age for the line between adult and child; the 16 kept is the launch's (children from 0 to 15), and so are the 52 pages. Only the applicant in person may file, the sick and minors excepted (Iwacu, March 2023). Processing time isn't modelled: the press reports long waits, not a published time.

sources.title: Iwacu, Le Burundi inaugure le passeport de l'EAC (29 May 2018)
sources.said: Le Commissariat général des migrations a lancé ce lundi 29 mai le passeport des Etats de la Communauté de l’Afrique de l’Est. Jimmy Hatungimana, commissaire général, fait savoir que la durée de ce passeport est de 10 ans pour les adultes et de 5 ans pour les enfants de 0 à 15 ans. Il a indiqué que le prix reste inchangé. Pour rappel, le prix d’un passeport ordinaire est de 235.000 Fbu. Le nouveau passeport contient 52 pages.
